suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as disease complication with chronicity guard. Require documented multiple myeloma and separately documented CKD after or attributable to myeloma-related renal disease. CKD chronicity criteria must be satisfied; do not relabel transient AKI or nonspecific renal impairment as CKD. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Multiple Myeloma and Chronic Kidney Disease / Renal Failure
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented multiple myeloma and separately documented CKD after or attributable to myeloma-related renal disease. CKD chronicity criteria must be satisfied; do not relabel transient AKI or nonspecific renal impairment as CKD.
